videos.title: [12 News] Today's Top Stories / SBS
videos.subtitle_summary: Samsung Electronics reached a tentative agreement on labor disputes, leading to union members voting on the proposal starting tomorrow. This has alleviated the strike risk and caused a surge in both KOSPI and KOSDAQ markets. Official campaigns for local elections and by-elections for National Assembly have begun today. Regional leaders and candidates started visiting their respective areas early in the morning to announce their platforms. For the first time since the Yemen war, our ship carrying 200,000 barrels of oil has passed through the blockade and is expected to arrive at Ulsan Port around the 10th of next month.

videos.title: 삼성전자 성과급 6억, 적자 내도 1.6억?...노사 합의안 총정리 [지금이뉴스] / YTN
videos.subtitle_summary: Samsung Electronics agreed on a significant bonus structure, fixing 10% of business profits as reward for employees. This decision will allow up to 6 billion won in bonuses for semiconductor division employees this year. Even the loss-making memory division is expected to receive at least 1.6 billion won in bonuses. The agreement also includes a new special management success bonus, which will be based on 10.5% of selected projects' profits without a fixed distribution ratio. This bonus could potentially provide up to approximately 5.4 billion won per employee if the projected profits are considered as business income. The semiconductor division may receive additional bonuses based on the existing OPI scheme, bringing the total potential bonus per employee to 6 billion won. However, loss-making divisions may not be eligible for OPI bonuses and will instead receive bonuses based on common resources' distribution ratio, with the implementation starting from 2027.
